biography.value:
Description

The earth medusa is a most terrifying female creature who had hair of living, venomous snakes, and a horrifying visage that turned those who beheld it to stone.

Defense

AC 26, touch 15; flat-footed 21 (+4 armor [-4 without mage armor], +4 dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)

hp 175 [238] (14d10+98)

mp 66

Fort +11, Ref +13, Will +12

Immune Death, Earth, Petrification/Statue; Resist Dark 10, Ice 5; Strong Lightning

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee +2 Dagger +20/+15/+10 (1d4+4/19-20), snake bite +13 (1d4+1 plus poison)

Ranged +2 Longbow +21/+16/+11 (1d8+2/x3)

Special Attacks Petrify, Petrifying Gaze

Spells Known (FC CL 14th, Concentration +19)

At will (DC 15) - Earth Orb, Message

1st (DC 16) - Entomb, Mage Armor, Sleep, Stone

2nd (DC 17) - Entomb II, Poison, Stone II, Stone Call

3rd (DC 18) - Bio, Entomb III, Sleepga, Slow, Stone III, Stonera

4th (DC 19) - Break, Rock Spikes, Stone IV, Stoneskin

Statistics

Str 14, Dex 19, Con 24, Int 20, Wis 16, Cha 20

Base Atk +14; CMB +16; CMD 30

Feats Combat Casting, Clustered Shots, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (Longbow)

Skills Bluff +19, Climb +19, Disguise +19, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +19, Perception +24, Survival +19, Stealth +21; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Terran

Gear +2 dagger, +2 longbow, 20 arrows

description.value: An earth medusa's snake-hair allows her to see in all directions. Medusa gain a +4 racial bonus to Perception checks and cannot be flanked.

An earth medusa can focus her stony gaze upon a single target within 30 feet. The target receives the Petrification status effect (Fortitude save DC 22 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

effect: An earth medusa can focus her stony gaze upon a single target within 30 feet. The target receives the Petrification status effect (Fortitude save DC 22 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).
Failed save: give the target Petrify: petrified (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).
